personality_one_liner: A modern, high-contrast, touch-optimized operational surface combining culinary warmth with crisp functional clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 44pt). Use distinct visual padding for operational zones (e.g., product grid vs. cart).

dont's: No glassmorphism on dense tablet data screens (POS terminal, Admin Dashboard) to maintain pure operational clarity and maximum performance.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure shift entry via PIN for cashiers and password for admins.

states.error: Shake animation on PIN pad + Red error text below input

screens.layout: Centered clean numeric keypad with large touch targets. Subtle 'Switch to Admin' or 'Role Switcher' toggle at the bottom. Brand logo prominently displayed at the top.

screens.name: Cashier Terminal
screens.purpose: High-speed order taking, customization, and checkout.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for products and categories
states.empty: Illustration of an empty basket in the cart section

screens.layout: Tablet-first Landscape: Two-pane layout. Left pane (70% width) for scrollable category tabs, instant search bar, and 3-column product grid. Right pane (30% width) fixed for current Cart, subtotal, and heavy CTA for checkout. Portrait/Mobile: Cart moves to a persistent bottom sheet or sticky bottom bar.

screens.name: Checkout Modal
screens.purpose: Finalize payment via Cash or QRIS and preview thermal receipt.
screens.layout: Full-screen or large centered modal. Split view: Left side for payment method selection (Cash denominations grid / QRIS barcode), right side for a live preview of the 58/80mm thermal receipt.

screens.name: Daily Sales Recap (Z-Report)
screens.purpose: Shift management, cash variance tracking, and end-of-day summary.

states.error: Failed to sync report - Retry button

screens.layout: Structured single-column or 2-column list of metrics (Revenue, Payment Methods, Toppings sold). Forms for inputting 'Opening Cash' and 'Closing Cash' with automatic variance calculation highlighting.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of business metrics, charts, and top-selling items.

states.loading: Skeleton loading for charts and metric cards
states.empty: No data available for selected date range

screens.layout: Grid of high-level metric cards (Today's Revenue, Orders). A large weekly bar chart section, followed by a 'Top 5 Sellers' list view. Sidebar or drawer for navigation to CRUD modules.

screens.name: Menu & Toppings CRUD
screens.purpose: Admin interface to manage product catalog and variants.

states.empty: No items found, 'Add First Item' CTA

screens.layout: Clean list view with thumbnail images, names, and prices. Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent 'Add Item' button. Editing opens a slide-over sheet or modal with simple form fields.

screens.name: Transaction History
screens.purpose: Review past orders with filtering capabilities.
screens.layout: Data table or structured list format. Top bar for date/status filters. Tapping a row opens a receipt preview modal showing order details.

empty_cart.alt: Abstract minimal illustration of an empty shopping basket

instructions_to_main_agent: Build with a strict Tablet-First mentality: Leverage a 2-pane layout for the Cashier Terminal (Categories/Grid on left, Cart sidebar on right). Ensure the layout is fully responsive and falls back to a Bottom Sheet for the cart on mobile.
Do NOT use glassmorphism effects; this is an operational POS app where rendering performance and high contrast/readability are prioritized over cinematic depth.
Implement high-contrast, oversized touch targets (minimum 44pt) across the board. Cashiers operate these screens rapidly, often without looking closely.
Use IDR (Rp) currency formatting exclusively. Add tabular-nums font variant where possible to keep prices and receipts aligned.
Checkout Flow Strategy: Keep checkout to 2-3 taps. Implement a fast cash denomination grid helper (e.g., Rp 50.000, Rp 100.000) that auto-calculates change.

Receipt Preview: Implement a view that mimics a 58mm/80mm thermal printer output. Use a monospace-like structure (or distinct layout with dashed dividers) for this modal to represent a physical receipt.
Maintain the warm culinary aesthetic using the primary brand color (#F59E0B) for active states, CTAs, and active tab indicators, grounding it against crisp whites and charcoal text for legibility.
Data structure note: Ensure the app cleanly separates the Admin environment from the Cashier environment, using the Role Switcher at login to toggle contexts.
